collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART IV (61-80, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: On a bad day, a villager reaches for the emergency snack hidden in the thatch and finds a very full lizard.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) keeps an emergency snack hidden in the roof thatch: a little bundle of dried fruit, wrapped in a leaf, for a day when things are going badly. Today things are going badly. (subject) reaches up into the thatch, unwraps the leaf, and finds a very small lizard, extremely full, asleep in the middle of it.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) looks at the lizard. The lizard, slowly, opens one eye and looks back. "Well," says (subject), "at least one of us is having a good day." (subject.He/She) puts the bundle back in the thatch, lizard and all. Somehow the bad day feels a little funnier now.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) goes straight to (friend) to complain. "A lizard ate my emergency snack!" (friend) tries very hard not to laugh and fails completely. Then (friend.he/she) shares (friend.his/her) own lunch. "Next time," (friend.he/she) says, "hide two snacks. One for you and one for the lizard."
